responsibility: Implements GCC’s path-prefix translation and canonicalization utility used to convert compiled-in installation paths into runtime-resolved locations. It rewrites paths rooted at the configured PREFIX into keyed forms, resolves @KEY and $ENV expansions via environment variables and optional Win32 registry lookups, collapses selected dot-dot path segments, canonicalizes directory separators for the host, and exposes update_path and set_std_prefix so other components can relocate tool, library, and include paths consistently.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation behind the prefix interface: it performs the actual path rewriting and canonicalization logic, including @KEY and $ENV expansion, optional Win32 registry lookup, dot-dot collapsing, and host directory-separator normalization.
